title: Multigame Mayhem
description: This mod adds items from other games into Minecraft! Games added includes: Mario, Deltarune, Terraria, and more!
body:
Multigame Mayhem adds items from other games and new achivments relating to those items as well as 2 new paintings. I won't list what games and what from here because spoilers, but some notable ones include: Mario, Terraria, and Deltarune.

Also, I have a feedback form now! Check it out [here](https://forms.gle/yoqKg2okEsmqeWFx6)!

<details>
<summary>Full list</summary>
Smash Bros: Smash Ball, Smash Ball Shard*

Super Mario Bros: Fire Flower, Super Mushroom, Super Star, Mini Mushroom, 1-Up Mushroom, Odd Mushroom*, and Dragon Flower*

Marble It Up: Super Jump

Terraria: Meowmere and Nebula Pickaxe

BTD: Dart Monkey, Dart, Dart Crossbow, Mastery Crossbow

Megaman: Megaman, Mega-Blaster

Multigame Mayhem: Odd Mushroom, Legendary Upgrade Template, Smash Ball Shard, and Dragon Flower

* Based off of items from that series
</details>

Primary Artist: Simon

Secondary Artist And Programmer: Tobin

Mod making platform and spawn egg textures: Mcreator team

Mob Skin Makers: Unkown
